model_annotations.Bulgarian: This line plot, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different network layers for three distinct conditions: “hidden state mean before gate” (dashed blue line), “hidden state mean after gate” (dotted orange line), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line starts near 0.1 at Layer 0, remains relatively flat with minor fluctuations until Layer 15, then rises sharply to about 0.9 at Layer 20, and climbs steeply to over 4 by Layer 22. The dotted orange line stays close to 0 across all layers, with a slight upward trend beginning around Layer 15, reaching approximately 0.1 by Layer 22. The solid green line remains nearly flat and close to 0 throughout, showing minimal variation and ending just above 0.1 at Layer 22. The legend indicates average values for each line: 0.71 for “before gate,” 0.05 for “after gate,” and 0.04 for “baseline.”
